# RStoolbox

[![CI](https://github.com/bleutner/RStoolbox/actions/workflows/rcmdcheck.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/bleutner/RStoolbox/actions/workflows/rcmdcheck.yaml)
[![CRAN
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/RStoolbox)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=RStoolbox)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/bleutner/RStoolbox/branch/master/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/bleutner/RStoolbox)
[![Downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/RStoolbox)](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/RStoolbox)
[![StackOverflow](https://img.shields.io/stackexchange/stackoverflow/t/RStoolbox?logo=stackoverflow&label=Questions)](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/RStoolbox)

`RStoolbox` is an R package providing a wide range of tools for your
every-day remote sensing processing needs. The available tool-set covers
many aspects from data import, pre-processing, data analysis, image
classification and graphical display. `RStoolbox` builds upon the
`terra` package, which makes it suitable for processing large data-sets
even on smaller workstations.

Find out more on the [`RStoolbox`
webpage](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/) or in our [`RStoolbox`
paper published in Methods in Ecology and
Evolution](https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.14451).

## Installation

The package is available on CRAN and can be installed as usual via

``` r

install.packages("RStoolbox")
```

To install the latest version from GitHub you need to have r-base-dev
(Linux) or Rtools (Windows) installed. Then run the following lines:

``` r

library(devtools)
install_github("bleutner/RStoolbox")
```

## Get started

`RStoolbox` implements a variety of [remote sensing methods and
workflows](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/RStoolbox.html).
Below are a few examples to get started. Further examples can be found
in the [documentation of the respective
functions](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/index.html).

### Example 1: Classifications

The example below shows an unsupervised classification workflow based on
*kmeans* clustering:

``` r

library(RStoolbox)

# unsupervised classification with 3 classes
uc <- unsuperClass(lsat, nClasses = 3)

# plot result using ggplot
ggR(uc$map, geom_raster = T, forceCat = T) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkgreen", "blue", "sandybrown"))
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/aUqzcxV.png)

If training data are available, e.g. labeled polygons, `RStoolbox` can
be used to conduct a supervised classification. The workflow below
employs *randomForest* to train a classification model:

``` r

library(RStoolbox)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)
library(terra)

# example: training data from digitized polygons
train <- readRDS(system.file("external/trainingPolygons_lsat.rds", package="RStoolbox"))

# plot input data
ggRGB(lsat, r = 3, g = 2, b=1, stretch = "lin") +
  geom_sf(data = train, aes(fill = class)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("yellow", "sandybrown", "darkgreen", "blue"))
#> Coordinate system already present. Adding new coordinate system, which will
#> replace the existing one.
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/s071ieD.png)

``` r

# fit random forest (splitting training into 70\% training data, 30\% validation data)
sc <- superClass(lsat, trainData = train, responseCol = "class",
                 model = "rf", tuneLength = 1, trainPartition = 0.7)

# print model performance and confusion matrix
sc$modelFit
#> [[1]]
#>   TrainAccuracy TrainKappa method
#> 1     0.9992293  0.9988032     rf
#> 
#> [[2]]
#> Cross-Validated (5 fold) Confusion Matrix 
#> 
#> (entries are average cell counts across resamples)
#>  
#>             Reference
#> Prediction   cleared fallen_dry forest water
#>   cleared      141.6        0.0    0.0   0.0
#>   fallen_dry     0.0       22.0    0.0   0.0
#>   forest         0.4        0.0  255.0   0.0
#>   water          0.0        0.0    0.0  99.4
#>                             
#>  Accuracy (average) : 0.9992

# plotting: convert class IDs to class labels (factorize) and plot
r <- as.factor(sc$map)
levels(r) <- data.frame(ID = 1:4, class_supervised = levels(train$class))
ggR(r, geom_raster = T, forceCat = T) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("yellow", "sandybrown", "darkgreen", "blue"))
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/uYgRj03.png)

^(Created on 2024-04-19 with [reprex v2.1.0](https://reprex.tidyverse.org))

### Example 2: Spectral Unmixing

`RStoolbox` offers spectral unmixing by implementing the Multiple
Endmember Spectral Mixture Analysis (MESMA) approach for estimating
fractions of spectral classes, such as spectra of surfaces or materials,
on a sub-pixel scale. The following workflow shows a simple Spectral
Mixture Analysis (SMA) with single endmembers per class, extracted from
the `lsat` example image by cell id:

``` r

library(RStoolbox)
library(terra)

#  to perform a SMA, use a single endmember per class, row by row:
em <- data.frame(lsat[c(5294, 47916)])
rownames(em) <- c("forest", "water")

# umix the lsat image
probs <- mesma(img = lsat, em = em)
plot(probs)
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/jNFfrn9.png)

Instead, one can define multiple endmembers per class to conduct a
Multiple Endmember Spectral Mixture Analysis (MESMA):

``` r

library(RStoolbox)
library(terra)

# to perform a MESMA, use multiple endmembers per class, differntiating them
# by a column named 'class':
em <- rbind(
  data.frame(lsat[c(4155, 17018, 53134, 69487, 83704)], class = "forest"),
  data.frame(lsat[c(22742, 25946, 38617, 59632, 67313)], class = "water")
)

# unmix the lsat image
probs <- mesma(img = lsat, em = em)
plot(probs)
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/f2b7cvn.png)

``` r

library(RStoolbox)
library(terra)

# MESMA can also be performed on more than two endmember classes:
em <- rbind(
  data.frame(lsat[c(4155, 17018, 53134, 69487, 83704)], class = "forest"),
  data.frame(lsat[c(22742, 25946, 38617, 59632, 67313)], class = "water"),
  data.frame(lsat[c(4330, 1762, 1278, 1357, 17414)], class = "shortgrown")
)

# unmix the lsat image
probs <- mesma(img = lsat, em = em)
plot(probs)
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/H6WDAMP.png)

### Example 3: Cloud Masking

`RStoolbox` comes with a suite of pre-processing functions, including
`cloudMask` to identify clouds in optical satellite imagery:

``` r

library(ggplot2)

# lsat example scene, with two tiny clouds in the east
ggRGB(lsat, stretch = "lin")
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/NJ86OKE.png)

``` r

# calculate cloud index
cldmsk    <- cloudMask(lsat, blue = 1, tir = 6)
ggR(cldmsk, 2, geom_raster = TRUE) 
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/bvgUd74.png)

``` r

# mask by threshold, region-growing around the core cloud pixels
cldmsk_final <- cloudMask(cldmsk, threshold = 0.1, buffer = 5) 

## plot cloudmask 
ggRGB(lsat, stretch = "lin") +
  ggR(cldmsk_final[[1]], ggLayer = TRUE, forceCat = TRUE, geom_raster = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red"), na.value = NA)
#> Warning: Removed 88752 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
#> (`geom_raster()`).
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/wwjXK3v.png)

### Example 4: Radiometric and atmospheric correction

With `radCor`, users can compute radiometric and simple atmospheric
corrections (based on dark object substraction):

``` r

library(terra)

# import Landsat meta data
mtlFile  <- system.file("external/landsat/LT52240631988227CUB02_MTL.txt", package="RStoolbox")
metaData <- readMeta(mtlFile)
lsat_t <- stackMeta(mtlFile)

# convert DN to top of atmosphere reflectance and brightness temperature
lsat_ref <- radCor(lsat_t, metaData = metaData, method = "apref")

# correct DN to at-surface-reflecatance with DOS (Chavez decay model)
lsat_sref <- radCor(lsat_t, metaData = metaData)

# correct DN to at-surface-reflecatance with simple DOS and automatic haze estimation
hazeDN    <- estimateHaze(lsat_t, hazeBands = 1:4, darkProp = 0.01, plot = FALSE)
lsat_sref <- radCor(lsat_t, metaData = metaData, method = "sdos",
                    hazeValues = hazeDN, hazeBands = 1:4)

# plot result
ggRGB(lsat_sref, r = 3, g = 2, b = 1, stretch = "lin")
```

![](https://i.imgur.com/IEi9own.png)

^(Created on 2026-07-21 with [reprex v2.1.1](https://reprex.tidyverse.org))

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ImageMetaData()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/ImageMetaData.md)
  : ImageMetaData Class
- [`RStoolbox`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/RStoolbox.md)
  : RStoolbox: A Collection of Remote Sensing Tools
- [`classifyQA()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/classifyQA.md)
  : Classify Landsat QA bands
- [`cloudMask()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/cloudMask.md)
  : Simple Cloud Detection
- [`cloudShadowMask()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/cloudShadowMask.md)
  : Cloud Shadow Masking for Flat Terrain
- [`coregisterImages()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/coregisterImages.md)
  : Image to Image Co-Registration based on Mutual Information
- [`decodeQA()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/decodeQA.md)
  : Decode QA flags to bit-words
- [`encodeQA()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/encodeQA.md)
  : Encode QA Conditions to Integers
- [`estimateHaze()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/estimateHaze.md)
  : Estimate Image Haze for Dark Object Subtraction (DOS)
- [`fCover()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/fCover.md)
  : Fractional Cover Analysis
- [`fortifySpatRaster()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/fortifySpatRaster.md)
  : Fortify method for classes from the terra package.
- [`getMeta()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/getMeta.md)
  : Extract bandwise information from ImageMetaData
- [`getValidation()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/getValidation.md)
  : Extract validation results from superClass objects
- [`ggR()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/ggR.md) :
  Plot RasterLayers in ggplot with greyscale
- [`ggRGB()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/ggRGB.md) :
  Create ggplot2 Raster Plots with RGB from 3 RasterLayers
- [`histMatch()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/histMatch.md)
  : Image to Image Contrast Matching
- [`lsat`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/lsat.md) :
  Landsat 5TM Example Data
- [`mesma()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/mesma.md) :
  Multiple Endmember Spectral Mixture Analysis (Spectral Unmixing)
- [`normImage()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/normImage.md)
  : Normalize Raster Images: Center and Scale
- [`oneHotEncode()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/oneHotEncode.md)
  : One-hot encode a raster or vector
- [`panSharpen()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/panSharpen.md)
  : Pan Sharpen Imagery / Image Fusion
- [`pifMatch()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/pifMatch.md)
  : Pseudo-Invariant Features based Image Matching
- [`predict(`*`<unsuperClass>`*`)`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/predict.unsuperClass.md)
  : Predict a raster map based on a unsuperClass model fit.
- [`radCor()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/radCor.md)
  : Radiometric Calibration and Correction
- [`rasterCVA()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/rasterCVA.md)
  : Change Vector Analysis
- [`rasterEntropy()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/rasterEntropy.md)
  : Multi-layer Pixel Entropy
- [`rasterPCA()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/rasterPCA.md)
  : Principal Component Analysis for Rasters
- [`readEE()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/readEE.md)
  : Tidy import tool for EarthExplorer .csv export files
- [`readMeta()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/readMeta.md)
  : Read Landsat MTL metadata files
- [`readSLI()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/readSLI.md)
  : Read ENVI spectral libraries
- [`rescaleImage()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/rescaleImage.md)
  : Linear Image Rescaling
- [`rlogo`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/rlogo.md) :
  Rlogo as SpatRaster
- [`rsOpts()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/rsOpts.md)
  : Set global options for RStoolbox
- [`sam()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/sam.md) :
  Spectral Angle Mapper
- [`saveRSTBX()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/saveRSTBX.md)
  [`readRSTBX()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/saveRSTBX.md)
  : Save and Read RStoolbox Classification Results
- [`sen2`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/sen2.md) :
  Sentinel 2 MSI L2A Scene
- [`spectralIndices()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/spectralIndices.md)
  : Spectral Indices
- [`srtm`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/srtm.md) :
  SRTM Digital Elevation Model
- [`srtm_sen2`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/srtm_sen2.md)
  : SRTM scene for the sen2 exemplary scene
- [`stackMeta()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/stackMeta.md)
  : Import separate Landsat files into single stack
- [`superClass()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/superClass.md)
  : Supervised Classification
- [`tasseledCap()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/tasseledCap.md)
  : Tasseled Cap Transformation
- [`topCor()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/topCor.md)
  : Topographic Illumination Correction
- [`unsuperClass()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/unsuperClass.md)
  : Unsupervised Classification
- [`validateMap()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/validateMap.md)
  : Map accuracy assessment
- [`writeSLI()`](https://bleutner.github.io/RStoolbox/reference/writeSLI.md)
  : Write ENVI spectral libraries
